cost: O(argument and optional params bytes + manifest bytes) parsing; loader, glob, SQL and report costs compose sequentially. Whole corpus and tales costs are unbounded here and were not run.
description: Database CLI dispatch and option adapters
forward: main collects args, checks minimum arity, creates a Duck handle and dispatches commands by name/arity. load_cmd parses source/dialect and value-bearing options, then loads files sequentially. prag_cmd/qa_cmd collect allowed flags in BTreeMap with last duplicate winning, parse optional JSON params and call loaders. init checks existence before parent creation; verify prints notes/failures then exits 1 for zero files or any bad result.
inverse: Missing commands, invalid load source/docs/match, unknown options and missing values cannot reach a successful loader dispatch. init cannot overwrite an already existing path. BrokenPipe from export stdout is explicitly admitted as success.

A parsed prag/qa option map corresponds to all flag sequences with the same final values, including overwritten duplicates. Defaults make omitted flags compatible with explicit default values; printed run count cannot uniquely recover CLI flags or DB state.
tales requires at least six args, export at least three, sql exactly three; unrelated extra args on some other commands are ignored by dispatch. This is a source-derived command-language partition.
prag requires run then source before params file parsing; qa defaults source opus and tool qagen source. Last duplicate flag wins in ordered map, but file errors precede invoking load.
Existence rejection occurs before create_dir_all and exec. If schema exec succeeds but schema_version fails, init returns an error with a created database potentially present.
corpus validates each six-column row and globs before loading that row's files; previously loaded files persist when a later row fails. No cross-manifest transaction is implied.
limitations: Finite helper/fixture evidence only; no DuckDB integration or SQL semantics
Partial syntax projection; no macro expansion or full semantic proof
No executable approximate profile or speedup claim
state: Unknown flag or missing option value returns before loader calls. Constructing Duck alone has no DB effect. Existing init target is left untouched. Corpus order is manifest order and matching/load failures stop later entries, without rolling back earlier files.
